Articulated_Plate_Armor.description: An empty, hollow suit of towering heavy plate mail animated purely by binding magic. Utterly lacking internal biology, it relies entirely on the structural integrity of its riveted steel plates for defense and locomotion.

Geared_Clockwork_Core.description: A dizzyingly complex, incredibly delicate chassis composed entirely of spinning brass gears, tensioned mainsprings, and steam-driven escapements. It moves with eerie, mathematically perfect precision.
